correctness.rationale: All 33 published line forms are transcribed. A complete exact loop checks all 528 pair-cross-product norm gcds (prime support only 2), all 5456 triple determinants (480 zero, nonzero norm prime support only 2,3,7), and 169 geometric intersection supports. Exactly 9 have projective conjugation fixed; for each of 160 nonfixed points the norm gcd of its conjugation cross-product coordinates has no prime factor >=5. Thus for every good inert prime precisely nine fixed points remain; for split primes all 169. Exhaustive finite-field enumeration confirms the p2 5-line reduced divisor and N2=6, the p3 N3=13 and 89 geometric points, and p7 N7=57. The universal result is derived from exact integer support rather than samples; the included verifier independently reproduces all critical finite certificates.

value.rationale: The field-of-definition profile of 169 singular points of a distinguished rigid free 33-line arrangement is a natural arithmetic invariant not determined by its combinatorial intersection lattice. The identification of precisely nine Q-points with the dual B3 reflection configuration and the sharp split/inert dichotomy Np=169 versus Np=9 give a complete structurally motivated classification. The characteristic-two reduced limit and the finite-plane filling phenomena in characteristics 3 and 7 clarify arithmetic boundary behavior without asserting they independently exceed prior geometric incidence tables.
